title: Tribune preliminary-agreement types — introduction
summary: The notes contrast a fully settled bargain awaiting formalization with a binding obligation to negotiate remaining terms.
notes: The first type treats the later document as memorializing agreement. The second can bind a negotiating framework while leaving final terms open. The full Teachers’ Insurance & Annuity Association v. Tribune opinion is a later SUPP assignment; it has not been silently added from external sources.
